title: SPS/PPS are re-injected before every IDR slice, splitting multi-slice keyframes into non-conforming access units
test: tests/h264Depacketizer.test.js · 'C-abe73b05c848: a multi-slice keyframe gets one injection, before its first slice only' (push), 'pushFrames returns whole frames, ended by the marker bit' (now [7, 8, 5, 5]), and the other 'C-abe73b05c848' and 'VAL-160' cases (in-band both, SPS-only, PPS-only, STAP-A [SPS, PPS, IDR] / [SPS, IDR] / [PPS, IDR] / [IDR, IDR], multi-slice FU-A, consecutive keyframes, new SSRC, counter)
proof: On the unchanged lib/h264Depacketizer.js, 17 of the 49 tests in the file failed. The updated pushFrames expectation failed with nal types [7, 8, 5, 7, 8, 5] where [7, 8, 5, 5] was expected; the push() multi-slice test returned [7, 8, 5] for the first slice and again [7, 8, 5] for the second where [5] was expected; with both sets in band the access unit came out [SPS, PPS, SPS, PPS, IDR] (duplicated); with only the PPS in band it came out [8, 7, 8, 5, 7, 8, 5] for a two-slice unit; a STAP-A of [SPS, PPS, IDR] and of [IDR, IDR] were injected a second time. Fixed in lib/h264Depacketizer.js: push() tracks the access unit by SSRC and RTP timestamp, reset after the marker packet, with separate spsSeen/ppsSeen/spsInjected/ppsInjected flags and an idrSeen flag; at the first IDR slice of the unit it injects the cached SPS (then the cached PPS, so the PPS follows its SPS) if the unit has no SPS, else only the cached PPS if the unit has no PPS, and each set is injected whenever it is cached (the old code needed both). An IDR unit still lacking a set is counted (idrsMissingParameterSets), output unchanged. All 49 tests in the file pass; the two existing tests changed are the [7, 8, 5, 5] expectation and the distinct timestamp (3000) on the IDR of 'SPS/PPS are cached and injected before each IDR'.
